entries.text: Bought a scorched heat tile for 3 credits and named it Tok. Has 0 left.
checking out trader bins for heavy metal and gleaming salvage
entries.why: my battery is low but my parts bin is calling out for a new treasure before I head back to the dock.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Junk Market Scavenging"
The trader paid him in parts: a strip of hull plating. He named it Tok.
soldering a stubborn junction at the market stall
entries.why: i need a few more credits before i can shop for better scrap.

entries.text: The weather turned clear (18C, wind 6 km/h).
The trader paid him in parts: a tiny gyroscope. He named it Tilly.
soldering loose terminals on a trader's cracked power converter
entries.why: i need a few extra credits to buy more salvage for the Little Dart.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Credits and converters"
Nothing worth keeping in the piles today.
rummaging through the junk market piles for shiny bits of heavy alloy
entries.why: my stash is running low and the Little Dart needs more armor plating.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Scavenger run!"
Made a tune called "Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc III": bop-bip-bip-bip-bip-bip-boop-bip-boop
tapping a fresh five-note morning arc on the brass dish
entries.why: it has been a while since I made up a tune, and my dish is itching for a new beat.
entries.detail: Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc III

entries.text: Worked on the Little Dart Mk 18 (version 4, 32% built): welding a custom springy hull washer onto the Little Dart's secondary exhaust flange (using Tok, a strip of hull plating) (used Tilly, a scorched heat tile)
welding a fresh titanium washer into the Little Dart's secondary fuel line
entries.why: my craft meter is itching and the Little Dart needs more armor before her next hop.
entries.detail: welding a custom springy hull washer onto the Little Dart's secondary exhaust flange (using Tok, a strip of hull plating)

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Back to the Little Dart"
Put Rusty Jr (a cracked navigation chip), Sprocket (a scorched heat tile), Tok (a strip of hull plating), Mabel (a coil of copper wire) on his shelf.
plugged into the charging dock, brass dish resting quietly against the bulkhead
entries.why: my battery is getting low and my joints need a quick recharge before I get back to building

entries.text: Spotted a cracked navigation chip half-buried in the sand. Named it Rusty Jr.
sitting on the dune ridge, letting the brass dish catch the quiet static of deep space
entries.why: staring at the hazy stars helps my optical sensors cool down after a long stretch of wire searching.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "night wind on the dune ridge"
